notice: Catalog entries are not all bundled or integrated. Verify model license, language coverage, model format, device RAM, and Android support before download.

runtimes.name: Android SpeechRecognizer
runtimes.offline: On-device mode is requested when supported; system service may use network otherwise
runtimes.notes: Android system recognizer. Must check isOnDeviceRecognitionAvailable before creating an on-device recognizer.

runtimes.name: Android TextToSpeech
runtimes.notes: Uses installed engines and voice packs; language and network behavior vary by engine.

runtimes.name: whisper.cpp
runtimes.notes: Local multilingual transcription; separate model files and JNI integration required.

runtimes.name: sherpa-onnx
runtimes.notes: ASR, TTS, VAD, keyword spotting, speaker ID and diarization depending on model.

runtimes.name: Vosk
runtimes.notes: Small offline ASR model packs; language support varies.

runtimes.name: Moonshine
runtimes.notes: Compact ASR model family; validate Android export and licenses.

runtimes.name: Silero VAD
runtimes.notes: Detects speech segments; does not transcribe.

runtimes.name: Piper TTS
runtimes.notes: Offline TTS with per-voice model licensing.

runtimes.name: Kokoro TTS
runtimes.notes: Compact TTS model family; model/export compatibility must be validated.

runtimes.name: ML Kit GenAI Speech Recognition
runtimes.notes: Alpha API; advanced mode is limited to selected hardware.

runtimes.name: Puter.js Speech APIs
runtimes.notes: Optional user-authorized web services for speech2txt, txt2speech and realtime beta. User-pays terms apply.

runtimes.name: NVIDIA Parakeet
runtimes.notes: Offline ASR model family; exported model and tokenizer/config required.

runtimes.name: Zipformer
runtimes.notes: Streaming ASR architecture commonly used with sherpa-onnx.

runtimes.name: SenseVoice
runtimes.notes: Multilingual speech recognition and audio tagging model family.

runtimes.name: FunASR
runtimes.notes: Speech recognition toolkit; select an Android-compatible exported model.

runtimes.name: WeNet
runtimes.notes: ASR toolkit and streaming model family.

runtimes.name: Meta MMS TTS
runtimes.notes: Multilingual TTS model family; model packaging and license review required.

runtimes.name: Coqui TTS
runtimes.notes: TTS toolkit; deployment depends on model export and license.

runtimes.name: openWakeWord
runtimes.notes: Wake-word detection; microphone service and battery policy need separate opt-in.

runtimes.name: Picovoice Porcupine
runtimes.notes: Wake-word engine; review SDK license and key requirements.

runtimes.name: SpeechBrain
runtimes.notes: Speaker recognition, diarization and audio processing toolkit; Android exports required.

runtimes.name: pyannote.audio
runtimes.notes: Speaker diarization pipeline; model licenses and Android export support vary.
